cropped subject: subject fully in frame with breathing room
extra fingers: anatomically correct hands with five fingers each
extra limbs: anatomically correct body with two arms and two legs
plastic skin: natural skin texture with visible pores
waxy skin: natural skin texture with visible pores
identity drift: the same face and identity throughout
gibberish text: only the specified text, spelled exactly
extra text: no text except what is specified
random letters: no text except what is specified
text cut off: text fully inside the frame with margins
wrong label: product label exactly as in the reference
deformed product: product shape exactly as in the reference
extra parts: product exactly as designed, nothing added
floating product: product resting firmly on the surface with a contact shadow
camera shake: locked-off tripod shot, perfectly stable frame
morphing: objects keep a solid, stable shape
sliding feet: feet planted firmly with each step
visible loop seam: seamless loop, last frame matches the first
jump at loop point: motion returns smoothly to its start position
fade at end: full brightness to the last frame
new elements appearing at the end: the same elements in frame from start to end
photographic texture: flat vector shapes with solid fills
motion blur: crisp frozen motion, fast shutter look
text: no lettering anywhere in the frame
jitter (moving camera): smooth, fluid camera and subject motion
_note: Keys are avoid terms. A key ending in ' (moving camera)' is used instead of the plain one when the shot has a camera move, so the wording never asks for a locked-off frame on a moving shot.
